paragraphs: S2P Platform Setup for New Orgs

sections.title: Platform Configuration
paragraphs: The following is presented as an unofficial checklist of the most important tasks in setting up a brand new S2P org. We have attempted to present the tasks in a logical order, but this document is not meant to be all-inclusive, to cover strategies/best practices, or to dictate the order in which tasks must be accomplished. All of these will vary based on numerous client or implementation-specific factors (for example, the availability of information from the client team). This document can serve as a place to double-check whether you’ve neglected to set up an important site element.

sections.title: Licenses
paragraphs: Verify that all appropriate licenses are enabled

sections.title: Site Profile
paragraphs: Site Display Name (for login page, and to fill placeholder for org name in notification emails)
Syndicate to data warehouse (enable if data is needed for reports in a non-production org)
Supplier Profile Access Permissions (applies to TSM, but enable it now if the client has TSM)

sections.title: Integrations
paragraphs: Understand which integrations are part of the implementation, how they are progressing, and how they will impact functional tasks of the Solutions Consultant. Common integrations include:

sections.title: Org Images, Messaging & Behavior
paragraphs: Obtain and import client graphics of all necessary sizes
Import any additional graphics needed for suppliers or supplier classes
Assign primary org logos (Setup > Site Appearance > Org Message & Site Logos)
On the same page, set up org message and site contact info
Create a color theme based on the client's color preferences
Set that theme as the site default (under Setup > General Site Settings > System Settings & Config)
On this page, also set up help options and default org home page
Modify (if necessary) Document Search Settings for all site documents (potentially including Requisitions, POs, Receipts, Invoices, Sourcing Events, Contracts, Form Requests, Savings Initiatives)
Modify (if necessary) Configure Approval Search Settings for all documents

sections.title: Org Structure & Settings
paragraphs: Certain permissions will not appear until specific functionality is turned on for the org. Take a detour and enable the following IF the client is using these features:
1. Email Approvals - Setup > Workflow Setup > General Workflow Settings.
3. Shared Cart – Setup > Configure Documents > General Document Config Settings

Configure top-level org role with all permissions and settings that will apply to any user throughout the life of the client's system; CAUTION: Keep in mind that as products are added in the future, the settings in the top-level role will apply to EVERYONE, so for example if setting up TCM only, don't give this role permission to Manage Contracts or all users will be able to do it.
Configure inactive 'umbrella' roles for all the functions available in the client's org

sections.title: Field Management
paragraphs: Modify fields and help text if needed
Teach client admin how to edit help text

sections.title: Custom Fields (ePro and AP only)
paragraphs: Create or Import Custom Fields (unless this is being done via integration)
Create or Import Values (unless this is being done via integration)
Go back to User Roles and set up Custom Field Permissions according to client needs

sections.title: Commodity Codes
paragraphs: Define or import client's commodity codes
Map commodity codes to JAGGAER taxonomy

sections.title: Document Configuration (ePro and AP)
paragraphs: Configure all documents in use, potentially including:
For each, the following steps will be part of the process:
1. Work with client to determine what information will appear and how it will be arranged on each document
2. Set up any Custom Fields that need to be added to existing system fields
3. Import XML or use templates for initial document
5. If using Contract Compliance Tracker, set contract settings for each document (whether to check and enforce budget and other contract requirements)

sections.title: Workflow
paragraphs: As the project progresses to product-specific configuration, import or activate workflow for each business process, depending on products implemented (actual configuration of these is listed as part of the product-specific checklists):
For each, the following steps will be part of the process:
1. Work with client to determine needs
3. Import Shared and Internal Folders XML file
4. Set up any necessary Rule Groups
5. Begin with an appropriate sample and modify the Workflow Definitions XML
Later, assign workflow approvers (and teach client admin how to do this)

sections.title: "Configuration" page
paragraphs: Appropriate settings under Misc. section (primarily attachment settings, search export settings, whether to show a supplier's JAGGAER ID number - most of the settings in this section are related to Spend Director and AP Director)
Email Settings (these are the settings for emails managed in Field Management)
Note: IF the client will need any of the Field Management emails and notifications modified, be sure to do that!
Email Addresses - 'from' and 'reply to' for various messages (again, these are for the emails under Field Management - and this is a good place to see a list of what is there)
Mobile subtab - set up mobile settings
Currency Configuration page - Enable applicable currencies and establish order of preference
1. Note: Settings on the Document Export, Alias Mgt, Certification Mgt and Shared Secret pages are handled primarily by the Technical Consultant

sections.title: ‘Administer’ Icon
paragraphs: Set up a default Dashboard for the org (other Dashboards are addressed as part of the product-specific implementations)
If users are not being added through an integration, add them manually or (more likely) import them into the system
Set up email management settings ('from' and 'replyto' settings for emails managed in this area)
Edit System emails if needed (and teach client admin how to do this)
